description: Enipedia is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Power plant portfolios > Enipedia", published or maintained by enipedia.tudelft.nl (publisher inferred from the link). (dead link) Enpedia was initially based on CARMA, but also pulls in data from Wikipedia and user entries. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Power plant portfolios" lists it under "Enipedia". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power plant inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
